# Haast

Haast is a Technology, Information and Internet company. Haast is an AI marketing compliance software that provides automation solutions to automate marketing compliance. They offer a manual compliance work that slows teams down, reviewing content and communications before they go live, monitoring digital footprint after, and regulatory horizon scanning. Haast employs 55 people (+61.8% YoY, +21 people). Headquartered in New York, New York, United States, with presence in Australia. Its workforce is distributed across 5 countries (including Australia, United States, Philippines, Netherlands, and Switzerland).

We help enterprise businesses manage compliance risk, enabling them to find and resolve regulatory compliance issues, across their entire digital and marketing presence.

# Haast International

Haast International is a Wholesale Import and Export company. Haast International is a global partner in defence, commodities, and strategic advisory, delivering high-quality solutions in complex and fast-growing markets. They focus on connecting regions, creating opportunity, and supporting secure, sustainable growth.

## About

Haast International is an Australian-owned and run family business with a global reach.

We have established reliable, long-lasting relationships with government departments and trusted suppliers in Australia and around the world, to ensure complete customer satisfaction. 

With over 18 years of experience, our team is expert in both Australian and Middle East customs compliance, security protocol, classifications, regulatory compliance, and customs clearance when exporting and importing products.
